conventions.api_call_format: Same format as upstream TestConflictingData clientActions: '<verb> <GroupVersionResource.String()> [ns=<namespace>] name=<name>'. Core group renders as '/v1, Resource=pods'. Cluster-scoped calls omit ns=.
conventions.absent_owner_cache_key: objectReference{OwnerReference: ownerReferenceCoordinates(ref) /* apiVersion, kind, name, uid ONLY */, Namespace}. Controller and BlockOwnerDeletion are never part of the key.
conventions.rest_mapper_semantics: 'discovery' = client-go restmapper.NewDiscoveryRESTMapper behind DeferredDiscoveryRESTMapper (what kube-controller-manager wires into the GC, core.go:660-678). For every served kind it registers Kind, strings.ToLower(Kind) and Kind+'List' (discovery.go:114-117). Resolution is pinned to the ownerRef's exact group+version; there is no fallback to another served version.
conventions.live: Objects that exist on the API server. A GET for anything not listed returns 404 NotFound.
conventions.worker_action: What attemptToDeleteWorker does with the queue item afterwards: 'forget' or 'requeue' (AddRateLimited, no retry cap).
